We propose a new model of online learning, called DCM bandits.

(1) We propose DCM Bandits, an online variant of the DDCM, where the goal is learning to rank with multi-clicks; (2) we propose a computationally efficient algorithm for this problem; and (3) we derive gap-dependent regret bounds and a lower bound for our algorithm, which are the first of their kind for multi-click problems.
